properties.description: BUILT 2026-10-25 under dec:loop-status-carries-one-repair-line. loop_status returns `repairs` {standing_patches, unlabelled}, read from repair_report (contained_symptom and unstated), and, when either is non-zero, one `next` line: "N standing patch(es), M repair(s) nobody labelled — repair_report lists each patch with the proper fix it stands in for; label a repair with add_change_event's `repair`". Not counted against `clean`: it reports what authors said and never judges it. No new tool. Code: crates/reflow2-core/src/repair.rs (RepairLine), crates/reflow2-core/src/report.rs.
properties.name: loop_status carries one line from repair_report: the standing patches and the repairs nobody labelled
